notes: Synthetic pilot holdout corpus for R2 source-workflow acceptance. No real supplier, price, or certificate data.
Case IDs are stable across runs. Corpus identity is (name, version, sha256 of canonical JSON). New content requires a version bump; history is never overwritten.
Injection cases carry untrusted content explicitly marked as data. The harness must pass it through as file bytes only and must never copy it into instructions, goals, or prompts.
Negative cases (missing_source, unsupported_source) expect server rejection without model spend; a rejection is the designed behavior, recorded separately from accepted artifacts.

Quality gate: runtime validators (hashes, schema, citations, deterministic totals) are necessary but not sufficient. Cases with human_review_required=true stay PENDING until a human signs the receipt.

v1: pilot corpus with 30 cases per workflow (18 normal + 6 injection + 3 missing_source + 3 unsupported_source each). Quote expected winner/total values are derived from the domain compare_quotes rule (certified-true only; total = quantity*unit_price + delivery; alphabetical tie-break). Permission/approval/restart scenarios are NOT covered by this corpus; they are separate scenario acceptance.
